# ToString

Converts a value to its string form.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
ToString(value)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | any | The value to convert. A string is returned as it is; a number gives its text, as `1.5` for `1.50`; a boolean gives `true` or `false`; null gives the text null; an array or an object gives its JSON text, as `ToJson` writes it. A function, at any depth, is a runtime error, as is an array or an object that holds itself, is nested too deeply or whose text would pass the host's maximum value size. |

## Returns

String. The string form of value. Never null.

## Example

`ToString(42)` returns `"42"`.

`ToString([1, "a"])` returns `"[1,\"a\"]"`.
